note: From the original description by Holmgren 1913 (in German). The alate is unknown; the soldier and the worker are described. The original in German was extracted by OCR from the Internet Archive scan; a few word forms and figures have recognition errors (e.g. l,i should be 1,1) and have been checked against the context; the measurements are in mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head reddish yellow; abdominal tergites glossy rusty yellow. Head with microscopic hairs and a few setae; the median abdominal tergites without rows of setae. Head shape largely as in the matangensis group. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 longer than segment 2, segment 2 slightly longer than segment 4. Anterior margin of the pronotum not concave.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head plate reddish brown; anterior corners and lateral parts of the transverse band yellow to reddish yellow; basal piece of the postclypeus yellow to reddish yellow; abdominal tergites rusty yellow; the rest of the body straw yellow. Head with sparse microscopic hairs and a few setae; hairs of the abdominal tergites slightly longer, with a weak row of setae on the posterior margin. Head slightly pentagonal, broad; cranial suture and fontanelle very distinct; middle of the transverse band concave forwards; basal piece of the postclypeus shorter than half its width but not very short, fairly convex. Antennae 14—15-segmented: in the 14-segmented condition segment 3 longer than segment 2 and segment 4 equal to segment 2; in the 15-segmented condition segment 2 distinctly longer than segment 3 and slightly longer than segment 4. Anterior margin of the pronotum distinctly concave.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Measurements (mm). Soldier: body length 3.7; head length including nasus 1.52; head length without nasus 0.70; head width 0.91; pronotum width 0.49. Worker: body length 4—4.5; head width 1.29; pronotum width 0.70. Distribution: Timor.
